entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I have an order... I think I need to do a return? I'm a bit lost with the website. It's all very confusing.
I can definitely help you with that. Can I get your name and order number to start?
It's Sarah Gable, and the order number is... um... VF789012. It's for a helmet.
Thank you, Sarah. I have your order right here. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, um, a preference, I guess? The color just isn't right. It looked different online. It's still in the original packaging, the box is unopened. I just don't know what to do. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can help. It's no problem at all. We want you to be happy and confident with your gear's color and fit. Your safety is what's most important, and feeling good in your helmet is part of that.
Right, that's what I thought. So... can I return it?
Let me just check the policy against your delivery date. I see here the helmet was delivered 79 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window, so a return is absolutely not a problem.
Oh, really? That's a relief. I was so worried I had missed the deadline. I get so overwhelmed with these things.
Not at all, you're all set. I have just initiated the return for you and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Do you have access to that email address?
Yes, I do. Oh, I see it coming through now. Thank you so much, Charlie. You've been a great help.

You're very welcome, Sarah. Just print that label, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
